title: Prime Access Trailer/Wisp
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - "In languid dreams a vision came, of new heaven, new Earth. I breathed life into its custodian. A subtle sprite, to seed life. Yet as I reached for my savage warden, she... slipped from me.
So now... ...I cast her in flesh. Yours.
Let her be real. Incandescent. This fugitive form. This... Wisp."
